title: How This Drunk Man Miraculously Survived Jumping in Front of a Semi
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On May 2, 2024, an officer responded to assist a Wisconsin State Trooper in pursuing a vehicle through West Salem, WI. The pursuit concluded when the suspect crashed their vehicle and fled on foot. During the incident, the officer witnessed the suspect standing in the middle of the interstate as a semi-truck approached at 70 mph. At the last moment, the suspect jumped aside, narrowly avoiding the truck which swerved into the median. After finally apprehending him, the suspect proceeded to fall off the line of humanity for the rest of the evening.

Our featured content aims to depict law enforcement interactions, emphasizing education over public shaming or ridicule. In a world filled with misleading conversations about law enforcement, it's crucial to present these interactions within their contexts to inform and educate the public.
